script_text: Stop scrolling, Leo! This week the cosmos throws a fire‑dance your way. Monday: Mercury trine Jupiter fuels bold ideas—perfect for pitching projects or learning new skills. Take a 15‑minute journal to capture insights. Tuesday: Venus squares Mars sparks tension in love; avoid heated debates, instead channel passion into creative art. Wednesday: Sun sextile Saturn steadies your confidence; schedule important meetings, but keep expectations realistic. Thursday: Mars opposite Uranus brings sudden urges—hold back impulsive purchases, plan finances carefully. Friday: Jupiter conjunct Neptune expands dreams; set a visionary goal and share it with a trusted friend. Saturday: Mercury retrograde in Libra clouds communication—double‑check emails and postpone contracts if possible. Sunday: Full Moon in Leo crowns your week; celebrate achievements, but watch for ego‑inflation. BEST DAY: Monday, when ideas flow effortlessly. WORST DAY: Thursday, when impulsivity spikes. Embrace the rhythm, stay grounded, and shine! and radiate confidence today.
